source: UCI Machine Learning Repository / Dr. William H. Wolberg, W. Nick Street, Olvi L. Mangasarian
positive_label_meaning: Malignant Breast Tumor (1 = Malignant in raw target, inverted if needed for risk probability)

feature_descriptions.mean_radius: Mean of distances from center to points on the perimeter
feature_descriptions.mean_perimeter: Mean size of the core tumor perimeter
feature_descriptions.mean_area: Mean size of the core tumor area
feature_descriptions.mean_smoothness: Mean of local variation in radius lengths
feature_descriptions.mean_concavity: Mean of severity of concave portions of the contour
feature_descriptions.mean_concave_points: Mean for number of concave portions of the contour

description: Features computed from a digitized image of a fine needle aspirate (FNA) of a breast mass describing characteristics of cell nuclei.
known_limitations: Extracted from FNA biopsy pathology imaging; requires laboratory cytology measurements.
